sources.title: AI-Powered Embryo Selection Market Size & Forecast 2026–2035
sources.claim: AI-powered embryo selection market valued at USD 379.20M in 2026; projected to reach USD 1,747.16M by 2035 at 18.50% CAGR.

sources.title: FDA Clears First AI-Powered Embryo Selection Tool in IVF Labs
sources.claim: Alife Health's Embryo Predict received FDA clearance on May 28, 2026, supported by 440-patient multicenter RCT across 7 US fertility clinics.

sources.title: AI Fertility Planning Platforms Market Growth and Forecast 2036
sources.claim: AI fertility planning platforms market reached USD 168.9M in 2025, growing to USD 205.0M in 2026 at 21.4% CAGR, projected USD 1,420.0M by 2036.

sources.title: Alife Health Receives FDA Clearance for AI-Powered Embryo Selection Tool
sources.claim: Alife Health's Embryo Predict FDA clearance details; CE Mark previously held in EU/UK. Regulatory milestone for AI medical devices in fertility.

sources.title: 5 AI-Powered Companies Transforming the Future of Fertility Care
sources.claim: Profiles of Vitrolife (iDAScore), Alife Health, Fairtility (CHLOE), TMRW Life Sciences, AIVF — major AI embryo selection competitors and their technology differentiation.

sources.title: World IVF Day 2026: The Global Fertility Economy
sources.claim: Fertility services market growing from USD 73.96B (2025) to USD 84.23B (2026) at 13.9% CAGR. Global IVF market context and economic drivers.

sources.title: TMRW Life Sciences Raises $105M Series C for Automated IVF Cryostorage
sources.claim: TMRW raised $105M Series C for world's first automated AI cryostorage platform. Additional $28M+ Series D closed 2024.

sources.title: AI Trends Shaping Fertility Tech Platforms in 2026
sources.claim: AI fertility tech use cases in 2026: ovulation prediction, embryo selection, sperm analysis, personalization, and cryostorage. Consumer and clinical convergence.

sources.title: iDAScore — Intelligent Data Analysis for Embryo Evaluation
sources.claim: Vitrolife iDAScore is a deep learning model for non-invasive embryo ranking integrated with time-lapse systems. Market leader in AI-assisted IVF.

sources.title: AI-Powered Embryo Selection Market 2025 Press Release
sources.claim: Market size stood at USD 320.00M in 2025. North America held 40% share in 2025. Asia-Pacific growing at 21% CAGR 2026–2035.

sources.title: Implementation Readiness of AI in IVF: A Multi-Framework Appraisal
sources.claim: Global AI adoption among IVF professionals rose from 24.8% (2022) to 53.2% (2025), with 83.62% indicating likely AI investment within 1–5 years.

sources.title: Alife Health Scores $22M Series A
sources.claim: Alife Health raised $22M Series A co-led by Lux Capital and Union Square Ventures for AI fertility decision support.
